integrity: All asserted finite-field identities derive from a self-contained count and an adjacency-matrix power identity, with direct dense matrix product enumeration and captured checker output as finite checks. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd field characteristic, odd ambient dimension at least five, rank-one nonzero B-self-adjoint square-zero factors. Polar graph is classical; only the precise all-arity ordinary-product target fibers, sharp width, and parity-switching exact mixing are assessed here. Prior-art search cannot prove global priority. Finite checker covers prime-field samples, not every field.
title: All-length products of minimal self-adjoint nilpotents: a parity-switching polar-space fiber law
